questions.prompt: Six-handed, folds to you on the button. Earlier positions have folded. You…

choices.text: Act now. The blinds still follow you.
Must wait for the cutoff who already folded.

questions.explanation: When it is your turn, act. Folded players are skipped.

questions.prompt: You are in the small blind. Two players limp. Action is on you before the big blind. You…

choices.text: Act now, then the big blind closes the action if nobody raised.
Are all-in for the small blind.

questions.explanation: The small blind acts before the big blind preflop.

questions.prompt: Flop is out. Button bet, small blind folded, you are the big blind. You…

choices.text: Face the button's bet and act now.
Can check the option from the previous street.

questions.explanation: There is no free option facing a bet. Call, raise, or fold.

questions.prompt: Someone acts out of turn and then action reaches them again. A safe approach is…

choices.text: Treat every out-of-turn word as a joke.
Follow the dealer's ruling; out-of-turn action may stand or be pulled back.

questions.explanation: Do not negotiate the rule at the table. The dealer applies the room rule.
